title: Medicare Open Enrollment Ends Monday, Dec. 7 — Time to Review Your 2027 Coverage
excerpt: Medicare open enrollment ends Monday, December 7, 2026. Laredo seniors and other beneficiaries have until then to review their health coverage, compare plans, and make changes for 2027 — changes that generally take effect January 1.
content:
Medicare open enrollment ends Monday, December 7, 2026, and Laredo seniors and other beneficiaries have just days left to review their health coverage for 2027.

Open enrollment is the yearly window to compare plans and make changes to coverage for the coming year. Changes made by the December 7 deadline generally take effect January 1, 2027.

Medicare generally serves Americans 65 and older, along with certain younger people living with qualifying disabilities or serious medical conditions. The four parts of coverage are:

Part A — Hospital Insurance: covers inpatient hospital care, hospice services, and qualifying skilled nursing care. Most beneficiaries pay no monthly premium.

Part B — Medical Insurance: covers doctor visits, preventive care, medical equipment, and ambulance services. Monthly premiums apply.

Part C — Medicare Advantage: private plans that offer Medicare-covered services, often including additional dental, vision, hearing, and wellness benefits.

Part D — Prescription Drug Coverage: helps cover eligible brand-name and generic medications.

Before choosing, compare costs, prescription coverage, and provider networks to make sure the plan fits your needs.
